brief.title: Discovery call — Self-service returns portal — 4 Sep 2026
business_goals: We need customers to be able to start a return themselves from their order history without contacting us.
Anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent.
Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in.
The system has to hold the refund until the warehouse confirms receipt.
constraints: Diwali week we did 12,000 orders a day; returns run about 8% of orders.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
